concerns.text: Task T009 (Environment configuration for data source URLs) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) but is required to satisfy Plan Methodology 1 and Constitution Principle II (Source Check). Without this task, the 'Source Check' gating logic in T009a cannot function, leaving FR-001 and the data source verification requirement unimplemented.

Task T022 (Property Range Extrapolation check) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted). This task is critical for FR-010 (New Element validation) and Plan Methodology 3 (Convex Hull logic). Without implementing the convex hull calculation and fold-skipping logic, the LOSO cross-validation cannot guarantee that test sets contain only elements present in the training set (interpolation vs extrapolation).

Task T024 (Null model baseline) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted). FR-009 and SC-008 explicitly require comparing the Random Forest model against a null baseline (global mean) and reporting percentage improvement. Without this task, the statistical significance claim (p < 0.05) in SC-008 cannot be validated.

Task T025 (Permutation Test) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted). Plan Methodology 4 and SC-008 require a permutation test on fold-level MAE differences to verify statistical significance. Without this task, the project cannot substantiate the claim of 'statistically significant reduction in MAE'.

Task T028 (Training time/memory constraint) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted). FR-006 and SC-003 mandate execution within 4 hours and <7 GB RAM. Without a task to implement monitoring or enforcement of these constraints, the computational feasibility requirement is unaddressed.

Task T029 (Save trained model artifact) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted). FR-003 and the Independent Test for US-2 require the model file to be saved to disk. Without this task, the downstream tasks (T032 for US-3) and the final artifact versioning (Constitution Principle V) cannot proceed.

All User Story 3 implementation tasks (T032-T038) are marked `[ ]` (unstarted). FR-005, SC-004, and the Independent Test for US-3 require generating visualization plots with specific fidelity checks (TCS, MAE). Without these tasks, the visual fidelity assessment and the 'representative binary systems' requirement are unfulfilled.

All User Story 3 test tasks (T030, T031) are marked `[ ]` (unstarted). The Independent Test for US-3 requires verifying plot generation and TCS calculation. Without these tests, the acceptance criteria for US-3 cannot be validated.

Tasks T001a, T001b, T001c, T002a, T002b, and T003 are marked `[X]` (completed) in the task list, but the 'Re-plan' section of the Analyze Report explicitly marks them as 'REJECTED' and 'REDO it' due to missing artifacts. This contradiction creates a false sense of completion for the Setup phase, which blocks all subsequent work.

Task T014 (Filtering logic for missing temperature) is marked `[ ]` (unstarted) but is part of the scope for T012-T018 which are marked `[X]`. The Analyze Report notes T014 was rejected. This leaves FR-001 (filtering for valid temperature) and the Edge Case handling for `MISSING_TEMP_COORDS` unimplemented in the completed tasks.
